plate.narration: The Saltrot flats lie under a thin wash of water. Reeds lean over the channels. On one muddy bank, a patch of snow shines white in the mild coastal light.

goal.text: Bring the stranded snowhorn goat home before the opening closes.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

npcVoices.Passing fisher: A fisher passing along the flats. She stops to study your warning, then makes up her own mind.

arrival.narration: On the Saltrot mudflats, an opening in the air blinks shut and open again. Through it lies snow. A snowhorn goat stands belly-deep in mud beside it, chewing a reed with great disappointment. Your Skupper guide from the Saltrot bank points at the rising tide. "Tonight we bring that goat home before the opening closes. I can find firm mud. I cannot make a goat like it."

observe.narration: Snow, empty sky, snow again. The opening returns narrower each time. The guide rests her fins on a firm shell. "We need the whole landing," she says, "not just a glimpse of breakfast."

observe_pattern.narration: Watch the opening blink, then show the order you saw. The next blinks may change.

interaction.cue: Watch the opening blink, then copy the order.

onSuccess.narration: You can tell a whole landing from a thin glimpse.

onFailure.narration: One blink slips past. "I will call the clear views," says the guide.

onAssisted.narration: One blink slips past. "I will call the clear views," says the guide.

sound.narration: Your Listening Chime is the one the glacier travelers gave you. A sour note means not ready. An echo means a way back is open.

interaction.cue: Ring the chime when the whole landing shows.

onSuccess.narration: An echo answers from the snow side.

onFailure.narration: Sour! The guide waits, rings again, and gets an echo.

onAssisted.narration: An echo answers from the snow side.

ground.narration: Two ways lead to the goat. The short mud dip needs your stiff mat laid underfoot. There it must stay. The long shell banks keep the mat free to make a low ramp later. Which way?

lay_mat.narration: Lay the stiff mat over the dip. The guide tests it with one fin. A small crab climbs on to test it too.

interaction.cue: Pass the stiff mat hand to hand to the guide.

onSuccess.narration: The short way is ready. The mat stays down.

onFailure.narration: The short way is ready. The mat stays down.

onAssisted.narration: The short way is ready. The mat stays down.

shell_route.narration: The guide knows these shell banks. Share her clues to mark the long dry curve. The stiff mat rides along, rolled up.

interaction.cue: Put the three shell-bank stops in order.
clues: The reed clump is the first stop beside the pool.
The white shell bank lies between the reeds and the notched ridge.
The notched shell ridge is nearest the goat.

onSuccess.narration: Your shell path is marked. The mat stays free.

onFailure.narration: The guide fixes one wet turn. The mat stays free.

onAssisted.narration: Your shell path is marked. The mat stays free.

shell_markers.narration: You set shell markers along the curve. The goat eyes the bag of shells hungrily. The guide moves it out of reach. "Road signs," she tells the goat. "Not lunch."

approach.narration: The goat tries to eat the rescue line. The guide tugs it back. "Front hooves free. The back pair are stuck. Calm it first."

calm_goat.narration: The goat needs a calm hello before anyone lifts it.

interaction.cue: Say hello to the goat, your way.

options.label: Offer a dry reed instead
options.reaction: It takes the reed and drops your line.

options.label: Hold a quiet open palm
options.reaction: It noses your hand and stops chewing.

options.label: Hum a small steady greeting
options.reaction: It listens. The line slips free.

onSuccess.narration: The goat is calm. The guide brings a reed sling.

onFailure.narration: The goat is calm. The guide brings a reed sling.

onAssisted.narration: The goat is calm. The guide brings a reed sling.

songkeeper_calm.narration: Your songkeeper hums low and steady. The goat drops the line to listen. "A very useful opinion," says the guide. "From the goat, I mean."

sling.narration: The broad reed sling spreads the pull under the goat. "Hold the sides while I slide it under," says the guide. Her poles prop up any side that needs it.

interaction.cue: Hold the sling's sides while the guide slides it under.

onSuccess.narration: The sling is in. The back hooves are stuck.

onFailure.narration: The sling is in. The back hooves are stuck.

onAssisted.narration: The sling is in. The back hooves are stuck.

lift.narration: The guide peers at the goat's legs. "The mud holds it like two stubborn boots. Loosen it first. Then lift gently, and keep it level."

loosen_mud.narration: The guide hands you a small flat tool. Wiggle it beside a hoof. No yanking. The mud makes a rude sucking noise.

interaction.cue: Wiggle the tool while the goat leans on the sling.

onSuccess.narration: The mud lets go of both back hooves.

onFailure.narration: The mud holds tight. The guide scoops up water to soften it.

onAssisted.narration: The mud lets go of both back hooves.

mud_recovery.narration: Pass the guide's little cup of water along the edge. She pours it around the hooves.

interaction.cue: Pass the water cup along the firm edge.

bigfoot_rim.narration: Your bigfoot breaks the packed mud beside the hooves. The guide shields the goat's legs with the sling. "Now lift evenly," she says. "Not harder."

lift_balance.narration: Lift the sling level. The goat pulls one hoof free, then the other, with a very surprised snort.

interaction.cue: Lift the sling together until it is level.

onSuccess.narration: The goat stands free on the firm shells.

onFailure.narration: The goat stands free on the firm shells.

onAssisted.narration: The goat stands free on the firm shells.

dry_patch.narration: The goat is out, but cold mud clings to one stiff leg. A warm leg will step more easily at the crossing. How will you help?

warm_goat.narration: The guide rubs the leg dry. The goat leans on the nearest hero and sniffs for snacks. Pick a small comfort.

mended_goat.narration: Your unicorn uses a gift called Mend on the strained leg. The goat stamps twice, pleased. "That leg will step easily at the crossing," says the guide.

rest.narration: The guide leads you onto a high shell bank. She opens her waterproof lunch basket: warm kelp cakes and broth. The goat stares at the cakes. "Eat," says the guide. "There is time before the crossing."

glimpse.narration: Through a full clear blink, a yeti herder waves from the snow. She knows this goat. It is a grown one from her herd. "I will take it from here," she calls. "You stay on the flats. That gap is no place for people."

signal.narration: The snowy landing is clear. Both banks need a way to say stop. The guide unrolls her soft signal mat. Or you could pass a quiet call down the line. The goat bleats. "Terrible signal," says the guide. "Excellent goat."

signal_visual.narration: The herder shows her mat signals. Watch, then copy them. Nobody moves the goat yet.

interaction.cue: Watch the mat signals, then copy them in order.

onSuccess.narration: You know the herder's signals now.

onFailure.narration: The guide takes over the signals. She will lead.

onAssisted.narration: The guide takes over the signals. She will lead.

signal_relay.narration: Pass the herder's quiet stop call along your bank. The guide repeats it back.

interaction.cue: Pass the stop call from helper to helper.

onSuccess.narration: The call reaches both banks. The guide will lead.

onFailure.narration: The call reaches both banks. The guide will lead.

onAssisted.narration: The call reaches both banks. The guide will lead.

crossing.narration: The goat can follow the sling into the herder's waiting hands. If it slips, the sling may end up in the snow. How will you send it over?

crossing_sling.narration: Wait for the whole landing and the herder's nod. Then guide the goat's front step. Everyone stays on the flats.

interaction.cue: Guide the step when the whole landing shows.

onSuccess.narration: The goat hops onto the snow. The herder catches it.

onFailure.narration: The goat stops halfway. Both banks hold the sling.

onAssisted.narration: The goat hops onto the snow. The herder catches it.

crossing_checked.narration: You know the herder's signals, so you move the moment she calls. Guide the goat's front step.

interaction.cue: Guide the step when the whole landing shows.

onSuccess.narration: The goat hops onto the snow. The herder catches it.

onFailure.narration: The goat stops halfway. Both banks hold the sling.

onAssisted.narration: The goat hops onto the snow. The herder catches it.

crossing_mended.narration: The mended leg steps lightly. Wait for the herder's nod, then guide the goat's front step.

interaction.cue: Guide the step when the whole landing shows.

onSuccess.narration: The goat hops onto the snow. The herder catches it.

onFailure.narration: The goat stops halfway. Both banks hold the sling.

onAssisted.narration: The goat hops onto the snow. The herder catches it.

crossing_recovery.narration: Hold the sling steady. The goat follows the herder's blanket. Let the wet sling go with it.

interaction.cue: Hold the sling steady while the herder takes the goat.

onSuccess.narration: The goat is on the snow, sling and all.

onFailure.narration: The goat is on the snow, sling and all.

onAssisted.narration: The goat is on the snow, sling and all.

crossing_ramp.narration: You kept the stiff mat free. Lift it level as a low ramp for the goat.

interaction.cue: Lift the stiff mat together until it is level.

onSuccess.narration: The goat trots up the ramp.

onFailure.narration: The goat trots up the ramp.

onAssisted.narration: The goat trots up the ramp.

ramp_return.narration: The herder holds the far end while you pass the stiff mat back. A ramp means extra carrying.

interaction.cue: Pass the stiff mat back to the guide.

onSuccess.narration: The mat is back on the flats.

onFailure.narration: The mat is back on the flats.

onAssisted.narration: The mat is back on the flats.

crossing_clear.narration: The herder leads the goat up the snowy bank. You pull every loose line back. The goat does not look back. It has snow to eat.

crossing_changed.narration: The goat follows the blanket onto the snow before the next blink. The wet sling stays with the herder. She waves it at you like a flag.

last_blink.narration: The goat is home. Hold the last marker while the guide reels in her line. One last blink shows a waving hand. Then the opening closes.

onSuccess.narration: Every hero is on the flats when it closes.

onFailure.narration: Every hero is on the flats when it closes.

onAssisted.narration: Every hero is on the flats when it closes.

record.narration: The tide smooths the hoof holes. Your guide has a driftwood warning board. Should it show the gap with its missing middle, or the safe bank where travelers can wait?

warning_picture.narration: You draw the opening with a bite missing from its middle. The guide checks it from the shell path. "Clear as a crab," she says.

warning_bank.narration: You draw the firm bank and the waiting spot. The guide checks it from the shell path. She adds a tiny goat for luck.

credit.narration: "What should the next traveler know about the rescue?" asks the guide. Pick one true part of the teamwork.

next.narration: The guide points out a trail to the Bone Yard, a place of old bones where anything taken comes back. Another path leads back to the buried bridge.

variants.text: Your picture warning stops a passing fisher at the missing middle. "I will wait at the marked spot, then," she decides.
A passing fisher follows your safe-bank drawing to the waiting spot. The guide nods. "The new marker works."

ending.narration: The snowhorn goat is back with its herd. The opening has closed. Your guide taps her board. "Wait until you can see the whole crossing." The flats look quiet again. This time, you know what to look for.

variants.text: The sling stayed with the herder. The guide will weave another.
Your stiff mat came up from the dip after the opening closed.
The shell banks kept your stiff mat free for the crossing.

warm_goat_response_shelter.narration: The goat stops shivering behind your packs. Its leg is dry and ready.

warm_goat_response_brush.narration: Mud drops away. The goat shakes one ear at you. Its leg is dry and ready.

warm_goat_response_reed.narration: The goat chews happily and forgets the sling. Its leg is dry and ready.

credit_response_guide.narration: The guide taps the board with one fin, pleased. The board shows what helped. It does not promise the opening will come back.

credit_response_herder.narration: You draw the herder's stamped landing. The board shows what helped. It does not promise the opening will come back.

credit_response_team.narration: The guide adds a little sling to the drawing. The board shows what helped. It does not promise the opening will come back.
